activity_summary: Below Ettington you sat with both feet in the brook and shaved by feel. The raw heel was bound in a strip of shirt. Edge Hill was behind you, and the bridge was still ahead.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat, shaved, and stayed until you were ready to go on.

facets.activity: Sat in the brook and shaved by feel

quotes.text: The strip will hold as far as the arches
